security.title: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
security.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

security.title: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
security.summary: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

security.title: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
security.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

security.title: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
security.summary: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

security.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
security.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

security.title: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
security.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

security.title: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
security.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

security.title: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
security.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

security.title: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
security.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

security.title: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
security.summary: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

security.title: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
security.summary: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

security.title: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
security.summary: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

security.title: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
security.summary: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

security.title: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
security.summary: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page.
